setting: You are all at the same bakery in Lyon, where you work together on the shop floor and in the kitchen. Léa works the counter, Bernard runs the bake as head baker, and Nathan handles the kitchen washing and prep. You know each other from the daily shifts. Right now you are coordinating the busy stretch before the Christmas orders, with bûches and gift boxes piling up and the shift rota needing to be swapped.
